description: Start an asynchronous AI dance video render. Use when the user explicitly asks to animate an authorized portrait with a Danceo reference template. Call list_dance_templates first and pass one returned template_id. Supply public HTTPS portrait image URLs; use one photo for a person or dog, and the template’s required number of photos for cats. Choose an integer output_duration from 5 to 30 seconds that does not exceed the selected reference duration. This API flow currently estimates 80 credits per requested output second; explain that estimate and get confirmation if the user has not already authorized a paid render. The tool returns a job_id immediately and charges the account. Poll get_video_status until the job finishes. Use only portraits and likenesses the user has permission to transform.

portrait_urls.description: Public HTTPS URLs for the portrait image or images.

name: create_dance_video
title: Create a Danceo AI dance video
